title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, our powerful new tool designed to provide you with deeper understanding and enhanced decision-making.

title: Streamlined File Experience
summary: Enjoy a more powerful and intuitive way to manage, upload, and display your documents and images right within your editor, providing ultimate control over your content presentation.

title: Transparency in Action: Our Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand new public roadmap to stay informed about recent updates, upcoming features, and our long-term vision.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, all with an updated look that integrates beautifully with the rest of our interface.

title: Seamless Team Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded our collaboration tools, making it easier and more intuitive than ever to work seamlessly with your team.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: Easily find and access all items shared with you, transforming how you collaborate and connect with others.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Get ready for a truly global experience as Noeko now supports a wide array of international languages, connecting users worldwide.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in our project's journey.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: We are enhancing your personal knowledge map with powerful new filtering and sharing options, transforming it into an indispensable tool for exploring your ideas and streamlining your workflow.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down and organize your knowledge base using powerful new filters and sorting options, then save your precise results as custom collections for instant recall.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Experience a more fluid and intuitive way to structure and interact with your notes through dynamic new layout options designed to better reflect your thinking.

title: Noeko: Flexible Deployment & Premium Power
summary: We are expanding Noeko's availability with flexible self-hosting options and powerful new plans, allowing you to deploy and scale our platform to perfectly match your team's needs.

title: A Vibrant Visual Refresh with New Themes
summary: We are revamping our current themes and adding several new, beautiful options to enhance your visual experience and express your unique style.

title: Smarter Time-Based Welcome Messages
summary: Our latest update ensures your homepage greeting perfectly matches the current time of day, creating a more personalized and delightful experience.

title: Quick Actions for Tagged Items
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new direct actions, allowing you to quickly unapply tags, delete, or view items without leaving the tag overview.

title: Unlock New Content Formats
summary: Effortlessly integrate a vast array of information, from dynamic videos to insightful web pages and text documents, directly into your workspace.
